title: 🌤️ Seasons & Weather (времена года и погода)
description: Учимся говорить о погоде, временах года, месяцах и обсуждать, что делать в разную погоду. Мемы, TikTok и погодные приколы! 🌡️

days.title: Day 1: Seasons and Months
days.description: Знакомимся с временами года и месяцами

grammar.title: Seasons and Months
grammar.rule:
📘 **Времена года и месяцы**:

🌸 **Spring** (весна): March, April, May
☀️ **Summer** (лето): June, July, August
🍂 **Autumn** (осень): September, October, November
❄️ **Winter** (зима): December, January, February

📌 **Важно**: Названия месяцев и дней недели в английском пишутся с **заглавной буквы**!

🎯 **Мем**:
'What's your favourite season?'
'Summer! Because no school!'
'What about winter?'
'Winter is just summer with less sun and more homework.' ❄️😅

vocabulary.example: In autumn, the leaves are orange.
December is the last month of the year.

exercises.question: What are the summer months? ☀️
Winter months are ___, January and February. ❄️
Autumn is from September to November. 🍂
My favourite season is ___ . (напиши время года)
The weather is nice in october.
exercises.correct: The weather is nice in October.
accept: The weather is nice in October
The weather is nice in October.
exercises.explanation: Месяцы пишутся с заглавной буквы: October! 📅

grammar.title: Weather — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как говорить о погоде**:

☀️ **It's sunny.** — Солнечно.
☁️ **It's cloudy.** — Облачно.
🌧️ **It's raining.** — Идёт дождь.
❄️ **It's snowing.** — Идёт снег.
🌬️ **It's windy.** — Ветрено.
🌫️ **It's foggy.** — Туманно.
🔥 **It's hot.** — Жарко.
🥶 **It's cold.** — Холодно.
🌡️ **It's warm.** — Тепло.
❄️ **It's freezing.** — Морозно.

🎯 **Мем**:
'The weather app says sunny. I look outside. It's raining. 
The weather app lied to me. I'll never trust again!' 🌧️😅

vocabulary.example: It's rainy today. Take an umbrella!
It's very windy! My hat flew away!
It's foggy. I can't see anything.

exercises.question: What do you need when it's raining? 🌧️
exercises.explanation: You need an umbrella when it's raining! ☔

exercises.question: It's ___ today. The sun is shining! ☀️
When it's cloudy, the sun is not visible.
It's ___ today. My hat flew away! 🎩💨
It is rain today.

days.title: Day 3: Weather and Activities
days.description: Что мы делаем в разную погоду

grammar.title: Weather and Activities
grammar.rule:
📘 **Что делать в разную погоду**:

☀️ **When it's sunny**: go swimming, have a picnic, play outside
🌧️ **When it's rainy**: stay at home, read a book, watch a film
❄️ **When it's snowy**: make a snowman, play snowballs, go skiing
🌬️ **When it's windy**: fly a kite, stay inside

🎯 **Мем**:
'When it's raining, I stay in bed and watch Netflix.
When it's sunny, I stay in bed and watch Netflix.
The weather doesn't change my plans.' 😅

vocabulary.example: We have a picnic in the park.
We make a snowman in winter.
We fly a kite when it's windy.
vocabulary.context_example: Мы запускаем воздушного змея, когда ветрено.
Я катаюсь на лыжах в горах.

vocabulary.example: We stay inside on rainy days.
vocabulary.context_example: Мы остаёмся дома в дождливые дни.

exercises.question: What do you do when it's sunny? ☀️
exercises.explanation: When it's sunny, you can have a picnic! 🧺

exercises.question: When it's windy, you can fly a ___ . 🪁
exercises.explanation: Fly a kite — запускать воздушного змея! 🪁

exercises.question: You make a snowman in summer.
exercises.explanation: You make a snowman in WINTER, not summer! ❄️

exercises.question: When it's ___ , we stay inside and watch films. 🌧️
We make snowman in winter.
exercises.correct: We make a snowman in winter.
accept: We make a snowman in winter
We make a snowman in winter.

days.title: Day 4: Reading — Weather Talk in a Chat
days.description: Читаем чат о погоде в разных городах мира

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай чат целиком, чтобы понять, где какие люди.
2️⃣ Найди, какая погода в разных городах.
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Обрати внимание на названия городов и стран!

exercises.question: What is the weather like in Moscow? 🇷🇺
exercises.readingText:
🌟 WEATHER TALK IN THE SCHOOL CHAT 🌟

The students are talking about the weather in different places. Let's see what they're saying!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🇷🇺 LEO (Moscow, Russia):
'It's snowing again! I'm so tired of winter. It's freezing outside! 🥶'

🇬🇧 EMMA (London, UK):
'London weather is always the same — cloudy and rainy. I wish it was sunny! ☁️🌧️'

🇺🇸 SAM (New York, USA):
'It's cold and windy here. But no snow yet. My hat keeps flying away! 🎩💨'

🇦🇺 MIA (Sydney, Australia):
'Guys! It's hot and sunny here! I'm at the beach. The weather is amazing! ☀️🌊'

🇷🇺 LEO:
'Mia, it's winter here! I'm so jealous! 🥲'

🇦🇺 MIA:
'That's because it's summer in Australia! We have opposite seasons! 🌏'

🇬🇧 EMMA:
'I want to go to Australia! It's always rainy in London... ☔'

🇺🇸 SAM:
'Emma, London is beautiful even in the rain! But yeah, I'd love some sun too. ☀️'

🇧🇷 CARLOS (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil):
'It's very hot here! 35 degrees! I'm going swimming after school! 🏊'

🇷🇺 LEO:
'35 degrees?! It's -10 here! I have to wear 3 jackets! 🧥'

🇦🇺 MIA:
'I'm going to the beach! Want to see my photos? 📸'

🇷🇺 LEO:
'Yes! Show us! Let me live vicariously through you!' 😂

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 WHAT'S THE WEATHER LIKE WHERE YOU ARE? 👇

exercises.question: What is the weather like in London? 🇬🇧
exercises.explanation: Emma says: 'Cloudy and rainy' — typical London weather! ☁️🌧️

exercises.question: It's summer in Australia.
It's very cold in Brazil.
exercises.explanation: Carlos says: 'It's very hot here! 35 degrees!' 🇧🇷

exercises.question: Leo has to wear 3 ___ in Moscow. 🧥
exercises.explanation: Leo says: 'I have to wear 3 jackets!' ❄️🥶

days.title: Day 5: It-sentences and Present Simple Practice
days.description: Учимся говорить о погоде с it и использовать Present Simple

grammar.title: It-sentences about weather
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как говорить о погоде**:

📌 Всегда используй **it** для описания погоды:
✅ It's sunny. (Правильно)
❌ I'm sunny. (Неправильно!)

📌 **Вопросы**:
❓ What's the weather like? — Какая погода?
❓ Is it raining? — Идёт дождь?

📌 **Ответы**:
✅ It's sunny and warm.
✅ No, it isn't raining.

🎯 **Мем**:
'What's the weather like?'
'It's terrible. I'm sad. It's raining again.' 🌧️😢

exercises.question: What's the weather like? 🌤️
exercises.explanation: All weather sentences start with IT! It's sunny! ☀️

exercises.question: ___ it raining? 🌧️ — No, it isn't.
'I'm snowy' is a correct weather sentence.
___ the weather like? ❓
exercises.explanation: What's the weather like? — Какая погода? ❓

exercises.question: It rain today.
exercises.explanation: It's raining today — идёт дождь сегодня! 🌧️

days.title: Day 6: Writing — My Favourite Season
days.description: Пишем текст о любимом времени года

grammar.title: Повторение: погода, сезоны, занятия
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What's your favourite season? (Какое любимое время года?)
2️⃣ What's the weather like? (Какая погода?)
3️⃣ What do you do in this season? (Что ты делаешь?)
4️⃣ What do you wear? (Что ты носишь?)
5️⃣ Why do you like it? (Почему тебе нравится?)

🎯 **Пример**:
My favourite season is summer. It's hot and sunny. I swim in the sea and have picnics with friends. I wear shorts and T-shirts. I like summer because there is no school! ☀️🌊

exercises.question: My favourite season is ___ . (напиши время года)
It's ___ and ___ in summer. (напиши погоду)
I ___ in the sea. (напиши действие)
I wear ___ and ___ . (напиши одежду)
I like summer because ___ . (напиши причину)
exercises.explanation: Почему ты любишь это время года? 💖
